name: AI 助手 (CodeBuddy)
description:
Embeds an AI assistant panel inside RenderDoc that connects directly to CodeBuddy (codebuddy --serve) and analyzes the frame you are currently viewing in real time. Each message is augmented with live frame context (API, EID, current action, pipeline, shaders); quick actions analyze drawcalls, pipeline state and shader disassembly. Supports CodeBuddy model selection via the ACP protocol.

Uses a ctypes/ws2_32 HTTP client so it works in RenderDoc's socket-less bundled Python.
author: renderdoc-mcp
